_description: PySpark APIs confirmed compatible with Snowpark Connect for Spark (SCOS) - verified against the SCOS relation/expression mapper, behavioral-differences doc, and kb_rules.json. Blocks containing ONLY these APIs skip ALL compatibility analysis, so the bar is strict: an entry stays only if SCOS is result-identical to Spark and never raises where Spark would not. The only tolerated difference is a pure performance/storage hint (e.g. cache/persist storage level, coalesce partition count) that cannot change query output. Any API that can change a returned value, change a type, ignore a semantically-meaningful option, or raise (date/time format translation, regex dialect, casts, UDFs, sampling, streaming, structured-object handling, file/format IO, temp-view materialization) is NOT eligible. NOTE: support in Apache Spark Connect does NOT imply SCOS support - reasons are grounded in SCOS specifically.
